metric.description: Precision/recall F1 over canonical 31-mer multiplicities. Canonical k-mers make the score strand-invariant, and nearly rotation-invariant for a circular genome: an assembly reported on the opposite strand is not penalised at all, while changing the reported origin replaces only the k-mers that spanned the old linear boundary and therefore incurs a small penalty - measured at 0.9981 for a 5 kb rotation. Missing, unsupported and duplicated sequence all reduce the score.
